notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.notes:
YEET I SAY!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45278645/dee0d6265658c41d9363077e261df3cab0cf0453.png

We’ve addressed a few reported bugs to improve your experience and adjusted the game to better align with its intended design by removing the save functionality. After all, some journeys are meant to be taken without shortcuts. Additionally, we’ve added a few hidden paths for those daring enough to discover them. Good luck!
